regime: Risk-Off Broadens: All Boards Below Their Stops
summary: Risk-off went broad. Tech kept selling ahead of Nvidia's Tuesday earnings and dragged the whole tape with it. The Nasdaq fell about 2.7% to around 27,292, below the stop it broke Friday, and the S&P gave back 1.9% to 7,442. Crude cracked, down 3.8% and losing its last long, while gold held up best, off 0.7%. VIX jumped about 24% to 23.58. For the first time this stretch, all four boards sit below their trailing stops. The whole market is leaning on Nvidia Tuesday.

event.name: No major scheduled release; tech de-risking into Nvidia earnings
event.consensus: Nvidia (NVDA) Q3 earnings land Tuesday, November 17 after the close; the market's key AI read.
event.actual: A broad tech and crypto sell-off: semiconductors led lower (Intel about -7%), Bitcoin slid to its lowest since July, and the Nasdaq fell more than 2%.
event.surprise: No data surprise, this was positioning. Elevated AI-chip valuations, rising capex, and a 10-year yield up to about 5.15% pushed investors to de-risk ahead of Nvidia.
event.nqReaction: NQ gapped lower and extended through the cash session to a 27,235 low, closing near 27,292, off about 2.7% and well below its ATR stop.
event.crossAsset: Risk-off across the board: ES off 1.9%, crude down 3.8% to 85.53, gold down only 0.7% (the lone relative hedge), VIX up about 24% to 23.58, tagging 24.52 intraday.

risk.sizing: Stand aside long across the board. The stops are all overhead now: MNQ 27,695, MES 7,510, December gold 3,890, December crude 87.13. No longs until a reclaim.
risk.openRisk: All four boards closed below their stops; there is no long left on the board. Do not carry oversized risk into Nvidia earnings Tuesday or the December FOMC.
risk.note: Stepped down to DEFENSIVE from REDUCED. The reason is the escalation: all four boards closed below their trailing stops, volatility expanded (VIX up about 24% to 23.58, tagging 24.52 intraday), and a binary Nvidia print is one session away. Longs are gone until a reclaim: MNQ 27,695, MES 7,510, December gold 3,890 and December crude 87.13 are all overhead resistance now. Keep size small into Nvidia Tuesday after the close and the December FOMC on December 9 to 10. Week ahead: Nvidia earnings Tuesday, FOMC minutes Wednesday, Walmart Thursday, and the December FOMC the next policy event.

psychology: Today was the opposite of Friday, and the difference is the lesson. Friday flushed and bounced, so dip buyers got paid. Today flushed and stayed down. The tell was the close below the session VWAP with no late reclaim, so the same dip-buy that worked Friday was a trap today. When price loses the opening range and never gets back above the session average, it is a trend day, and trend days reward patience on the short side and punish the reflex to catch a falling knife. With the whole board under its stops and a binary Nvidia print one session away, the right size is small. You do not need a position into an event like that. Cash is a position too.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal (MNQ)
fullReport.html: MNQ: session VWAP 27,416; 2-sigma 27,611 / 27,220; 3-sigma 27,709 / 27,122. The session low printed 27,234.75, which tagged the lower 2-sigma but did not reach the 27,122 lower 3-sigma, and it did not revert. Price closed 27,292, below VWAP. On a trending day a band tag is stretched-but-trending, not the reversion long it was Friday.

fullReport.title: Yesterday's Map: Marked
fullReport.html:
#Map row (IF)ResultMeasured
1MNQ stays below the 28,236 ATR stop and the 28,000 round (2 hourly closes)TRIGGERED - PLAYED OUTThe down scenario was the day. After a brief overnight pop above the stop to 28,279, MNQ opened the cash session at 27,533, far below both the 28,236 stop and the 28,000 round, and never looked back. It lost Friday's 27,690 low, ran to a 27,235 session low through the 28,000 and 27,500 psych levels the row pointed to, and closed 27,292. Bias down played out in full.
2MNQ reclaims the 28,000 round and then the 28,236 ATR stop (2 hourly closes)NOT TRIGGEREDThe reclaim never completed. MNQ popped above 28,000 overnight and tagged the 28,236 stop to a 28,279 high, but it closed only one hourly bar above the stop, short of the two the row required, then reversed hard. The row's own warning, a tag of the stop that stalls is the short, is exactly what paid.
3MES stays below the 7,607 ATR stop and the 7,550 roundTRIGGERED - PLAYED OUTPlayed out and then some. After a one-bar overnight poke to 7,614, MES spent the cash session below the 7,607 stop and the 7,550 round, falling through the 7,519 session low and the 7,512 lower 3-sigma the row named, all the way to a 7,420 low before closing 7,442.
4December gold stays below the 3,919 stop and inside the 3,870 to 3,900 rangeTRIGGERED - MIXEDHalf and half. Gold stayed below the 3,919 stop all session as the bias read, short intact. But it did not hold the 3,870 to 3,900 range, losing 3,870 and sliding to a 3,835 low, the downside the row flagged with losing 3,870 reopens the 3,850 psych. It closed 3,855, right at that psych level. Bias right, the range broke lower.
5December crude holds above the 87.70 stop and the 88 roundNOT TRIGGEREDThe hold never happened. Crude opened the week heavy and lost the 87.70 stop and the 88 round at once, flipping its long to short. It fell through the 87 and 86 handles to an 85.33 low, off about 3.8%, and closed 85.53. The up-bias did not trigger; the row's own losing 87.70 reopens 88 and 87 caveat is what played.

Score: 5 rows, 3 triggered, 2 played out, 1 mixed, 0 failed, 2 not triggered.  |  Month MTD: 50 rows, 38 triggered, 21 played out, 15 mixed, 2 failed.
